# MADE (made.expert)

> Industrial marketing and communications consultancy of Katerina Braga, Vienna. Helping technical companies and consultancies in energy and industry explain complex offers clearly and convince their buyers. Strategy and hands-on delivery.

MADE is the practice of Katerina Braga, operating as Marketing Agency "Digital Energy" e.U., based in Vienna, Austria, working across Europe. Katerina spent 20 years on the client side of B2B decisions in energy, oil & gas, IT and telecom, in Ukraine and across Europe, and built marketing and communications functions from scratch five times. Most recently she was Head of Corporate and Marketing Communications at one of Europe's largest underground gas storage operators, where that work supported 79% growth in the international client base within two years. She holds a CIM Diploma in Professional Marketing from Oxford College of Marketing (2025) and is a Certified LinkedIn Expert. Working languages: English, German, Ukrainian, Russian.

## Offers

Three projects with a fixed scope:
- Personal brand & LinkedIn for tech experts: a clear expert position, a rewritten profile, the first publications and a 90-day plan the client's team can run.
- Positioning & messaging for products and services: one agreed version of the offer, tested against what three of the client's own buyers say, with the messages and page copy that follow from it.
- Sales presentations & solution briefs: the presentation, the solution brief, the datasheet and answers to the objections that come up in every deal.

Ongoing support, month to month with a minimum term:
- Part-time marketing manager: runs the marketing for companies without a marketing function (expert and founder visibility, outreach to named target companies, content, the website).
- Fractional marketing lead: owns the plan and priorities and steers the people who deliver.

After a project, the work continues in one of three ways: Katerina delivers it, the client's team delivers it under her supervision, or the client's team works on its own with AI-supported workflows and templates she sets up.
